ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the graph, the vertical axis is “daily variation value of solar altitude,” and the horizontal axis is “date”; the left end is marked 3.21; the curve first rises to about 30°, then maintains a high-value plateau near 30° for a period, and ③ is marked in the latter part on the right side of the high-value plateau, close to the position where the plateau ends, after which the curve turns downward. Then reason: after the spring equinox, the direct solar point moves northward, reaching its northernmost position around the summer solstice; after passing the maximum position of northward movement, the direct solar point begins to move southward. In the graph, ③ is located at the stage around before and after the end of the high-value plateau, so it can be judged that at this time it has already passed the maximum position of northward movement; therefore, on date ③, the direct solar point is moving southward.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：横轴是日期，左端标出3.21，曲线先上升到30°附近，③位于高值平台结束后的阶段，说明此时太阳直射点已经过了北移的极大位置。再看文字：题目问③日期直射点向哪个方向移动。关键桥梁是太阳直射点在夏至前北移、夏至后南移；③处在北移结束之后，所以应判定为向南移动。
